title: KeyList
description: The body of https://api.trooth.co/public/keys, or a saved copy of it. Save it with the time you read it: a saved list cannot show a compromise announced later.

list_read_at.description: When the list was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

active_kid.description: The kid of the key currently used for new statements.

note.description: A note from the key service.

PublicKey.title: PublicKey
PublicKey.description: One published key and its lifecycle. Only `kid`, `alg`, `encoding`, `public_key`, `status` and the three lifecycle times decide trust (docs/VERIFY.md section 3).

kid.description: The key id a statement names in key_id.

encoding.description: How public_key is written: hex or base64.

state.description: The same lifecycle state as written by the key service.

retired_at.description: When the key was retired. Statements carrying a read_at strictly before this stay trusted. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

compromised_at.description: When the key was found compromised. Nothing signed by it is relied on. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

revoked_at.description: When the key was revoked. A revocation with no compromise recorded is treated as a compromise. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

created_at.description: When the key was created, when recorded. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

activated_at.description: When the key was first used, when recorded. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

first_listed_at.description: When the key first appeared on the list. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

fingerprint.description: A short fingerprint of the key, for display.

purpose.description: What the key is for, as a short label.

signs.description: What the key signs, in words.

KeyEvent.title: KeyEvent
KeyEvent.description: One lifecycle event of a key.

event.description: What happened (for example first_listed, retired, compromised).

at.description: When. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).
